zh:
西北大学（Northwestern University）成立于1851年，主校区位于美国伊利诺伊州埃文斯顿市，在芝加哥市中心设有分校区，是美国顶尖的私立研究型大学，也是十大联盟成员高校。学校下设12个学院，覆盖医学、法律、商学、工程、艺术、教育等领域，在校生超22000人，其中研究生约12000名。
西北大学在2026QS世界大学排名中位列全球第42位，其凯洛格商学院、教育与社会政策学院、普利兹克法学院、麦考密克工程学院均处于全美顶尖水平。学校培养了21位诺贝尔奖得主、1位图灵奖得主，在材料科学、纳米技术、经济学、新闻传播、医学等领域拥有卓越的学术实力，注重跨学科研究与创新。
en: Northwestern University is a private research university in the United States. Founded in 1851, its main campus is in Evanston, Illinois, with an additional campus in downtown Chicago. The University comprises 12 schools, covering medicine, law, business, engineering, arts, and education, with over 22,000 enrolled students, including 12,000 graduate students. Ranked 42nd globally in the 2026 QS World University Rankings, its Kellogg School of Management, Pritzker School of Law, and McCormick School of Engineering are among the top in the United States. It has produced 21 Nobel Prize winners and 1 Turing Award winner. Ranked No.42 in the world in the 2026 QS World University Rankings.
